issue: No primary key column; rows are only unique on a 7-column combination
decision: Added surrogate key flight_id (1 to N, in the original row order)

issue: Fully duplicated rows (check)
decision: None found; no action needed

issue: Clock times stored as HHMM numbers (517 = 05:17), read as decimals because of blank rows
decision: Departures converted to full DATETIME columns; arrivals converted to TIME columns

issue: Value 2400 used for midnight (not a valid clock time)
decision: Converted to 00:00 of the next day in actual_dep_datetime

issue: Value 2400 used for midnight (not a valid clock time)
decision: Converted to 00:00:00 in actual_arr_time

issue: Actual departure was on the day after the scheduled date, but the file has no actual date
decision: Built actual_dep_datetime with the correct date, using dep_delay to detect the day change

issue: Delay differs from the clock difference by 1 hour (flights delayed across a daylight-saving change)
decision: Kept as is; the delay is correct elapsed time. Documented

issue: All departure and arrival fields missing: the flight was cancelled
decision: Rows kept, values left missing (not filled with 0). Flagged flight_status = 'cancelled'

issue: Flight departed but has no arrival delay or air time (diverted or arrival not recorded)
decision: Rows kept, values left missing. Flagged flight_status = 'diverted_or_incomplete'

issue: Missing tail number (all on cancelled flights)
decision: Left missing; no aircraft was assigned

issue: Redundant copies of sched_dep_time, stored as decimals
decision: Dropped; the same information is in sched_dep_datetime

issue: Date split over three columns (year is always 2023)
decision: Combined into one DATE column, flight_date

issue: Whole numbers stored as decimals (203.0)
decision: Converted to integers that allow missing values; units added to the column names

issue: Implied average speed above 700 mph (air_time probably too short)
decision: Kept unchanged; no reliable value to correct it with. Documented

issue: Arrival delay does not match the arrival clock times
decision: Kept unchanged; cannot tell which field is wrong. Documented

issue: Tail number written without the leading N (all Allegiant Air, e.g. 203NV)
decision: Prefixed with N so all tail numbers share one format

issue: Codes missing from airlines / airports lookup tables (check)
decision: None found; these three foreign keys are fully valid

issue: Tail number not in the planes table (277 distinct aircraft)
decision: Flights and tail numbers kept; documented exception (use LEFT JOIN, no strict foreign key)

issue: No weather row exists for the flight's origin and hour
decision: Flights kept; documented exception (use LEFT JOIN)

issue: 12 spellings for 7 manufacturers (e.g. AIRBUS / AIRBUS INDUSTRIE / AIRBUS SAS)
decision: Standardised to 7 names with an explicit mapping (see section 3.2)

issue: Value is 0 on every row; no information
decision: Column dropped

issue: Stored as decimal; ambiguous name that clashes with a MySQL keyword
decision: Converted to integer and renamed year_manufactured

issue: Missing year of manufacture
decision: Left missing; not imputed

issue: Aircraft type impossible for an airline flight (1 rotorcraft, 1 four-seat piston plane)
decision: Kept unchanged; documented as suspect records (registration probably re-used)

issue: A330-223 listed with 3 engines (the type has 2)
decision: Kept unchanged; documented as suspect records

issue: Seat count is a registry reference figure, not the installed cabin (e.g. A321 with 379 seats, ERJ 190 with 20)
decision: Kept unchanged; warning added to the data dictionary

issue: Missing UTC offset and daylight-saving code
decision: Left missing; none of these airports is used by a flight

issue: Missing time-zone name
decision: Left missing; none of these airports is used by a flight

issue: Code 'U' (unknown) is a missing value in disguise
decision: Converted to a real missing value

issue: Impossible UTC offset: RHV (California) has +8; OEL has -5 but coordinates in Russia
decision: Set to missing (and dst for OEL); not guessed

issue: EMT (California) has the European daylight-saving code 'E'
decision: Set to missing; not guessed

issue: Same airport name used by different airports
decision: Kept; they are different airports. faa is the key, never the name

issue: Names with accented characters
decision: Kept; files exported as UTF-8

issue: Hours with no weather row: all of 31 Dec at 3 airports, plus 1 hour at LGA on 2 May
decision: Not imputed; no rows created. Documented

issue: Not a measurement: exactly wind_speed x 1.15078 (knots-to-mph factor) on every row
decision: Column dropped

issue: Missing wind speed
decision: Left missing; not imputed

issue: Missing wind direction (includes hours with variable wind)
decision: Left missing; not imputed

issue: Value 0 means calm (no wind), not north
decision: Kept; meaning documented in the data dictionary

issue: Missing temperature, dew point and humidity
decision: Left missing; not imputed

issue: Missing pressure
decision: Left missing; not imputed

issue: Missing visibility
decision: Left missing; not imputed

issue: Value 0.0001 is a code for a trace amount, not a measurement
decision: Kept; meaning documented in the data dictionary

issue: Redundant copies of time_hour
decision: Dropped; time_hour is kept

issue: Daily temperature cycle peaks 3 to 4 hours late: timestamps may be UTC, not local time
decision: Not changed (cannot be confirmed from the files). Documented as a limitation

issue: Coordinate values with more than 6 decimals (number-format noise)
decision: Rounded to 6 decimals (about 10 cm); no real precision lost

issue: Generic column name (every lookup table has a 'name')
decision: Renamed to airline_name; no value changes needed

issue: Generic or unit-less column names
decision: Renamed to airport_name, alt_ft, utc_offset_hours
